title: docs(cli): document --debug modes and --run-agents
body:
## Summary
- Document the optional `inspector`/`cli` mode of `playwright test --debug` (added in #39717) in both options tables
- Add the missing `--run-agents <mode>` row (`missing`/`all`/`none`, default `none`) that `--help` already prints (visible again since #38917)

Fixes #42889
